svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three the same, 20 x 20 x 16 mm, in black ASA.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 5 mm bore on the axis from the wall face, 12 deep, for the LED

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (left wall) or a light-to-frequency detector (front and right).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 3 mm hole from the bore out of the top for the leads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 3.4 mm holes at opposite corners, 3.5 in from the edges, for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M3 screws into tapped holes beside each window.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seat the LED or detector against the window disc, pot it in black

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: epoxy so no daylight leaks in, and lead the wires out of the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: face flat on the cell wall, centred on its window.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: in the dark, the detector reads the same with the room
